name: trpc
description_en: 🧙‍♀️  Move Fast and Break Nothing. End-to-end typesafe APIs made easy.
readme_excerpt: tRPC Move fast and break nothing. End-to-end typesafe APIs made easy. The client above is not importing any code from the server, only its type declarations. Intro tRPC allows you to easily build & consume fully typesafe APIs without schemas or code generation. Features - ✅  Well-tested and production ready. - 🧙‍♂️  Full static typesafety & autocompletion on the client, for inputs, outputs, and errors. - 🐎  Snappy DX - No code generation, run-time bloat, or build pipeline. - 🍃…
